title: In Situ Coordination-Catalyzed o-Vanillin Underwent a One-Pot Tandem Reaction to Construct Complex Chiral Tetrameric Isomer-Based Hexanuclear Clusters

material_class.structural_family: chair-like hexanuclear Dy6 cluster based on a chiral o-vanillin tetramer ligand (L_R^1)4−

synthesis.procedure: 0.1 mmol (1R,2R)-1,2-diphenylethylenediamine (22.1 mg), 0.2 mmol o-vanillin (31.3 mg), and 0.2 mmol Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (91.2 mg) were placed in a Pyrex tube (~25 cm). 0.5 mL anhydrous methanol was added and the mixture shaken until dissolved. 20 μL acetic acid was added, followed by 0.5 mL methanol and 1.0 mL acetonitrile (total mixed solvent 2 mL, V_MeOH/V_MeCN = 1:1). The sealed mixture was kept under solvothermal conditions at 80 °C for 48 h, then slowly cooled to room temperature (wrapped and placed in an incubator) to give yellow block crystals of R-Dy6.
synthesis.temperature: 80 °C (solvothermal); then slow cooling to room temperature
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: After 48 h at 80 °C, the tube was taken out, wrapped, and slowly cooled at room temperature in an incubator to obtain yellow block crystals.

properties.summary: DC magnetic data (2–300 K, 1000 Oe) show χmT(300 K) = 83.18 cm3 K mol−1, below the 85.02 cm3 K mol−1 expected for six free Dy(III) ions, decreasing to 42.13 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K; magnetization at 2 K/7 T is 35.26 Nβ (well below 60 Nβ) and M–HT−1 curves do not overlay, indicating magnetic anisotropy and/or low-lying excited states from crystal-field splitting and/or coupling. UV–vis absorptions at 270 and 345 nm (n–π and π–π*) match the CD spectrum of the R enantiomer. Photodynamic ROS generation is reported but is not a cluster luminescence measurement.

material_class.structural_family: chair-like hexanuclear Dy6 cluster based on a chiral o-vanillin tetramer ligand (L_S^1)4−

synthesis.procedure: Prepared analogously to R-Dy6, replacing (1R,2R)-1,2-diphenylethylenediamine with (1S,2S)-1,2-diphenylethylenediamine. Same reagent loadings as R-Dy6: 0.1 mmol diamine, 0.2 mmol o-vanillin, 0.2 mmol Dy(NO3)3·6H2O, 20 μL acetic acid, MeOH/MeCN 1:1 (2 mL total) in a sealed Pyrex tube, 80 °C solvothermal for 48 h, then slow cooling to give crystals of S-Dy6.
synthesis.temperature: 80 °C (solvothermal); then slow cooling to room temperature
synthesis.vessel_or_method: sealed Pyrex tube, solvothermal (same as R-Dy6)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Slow cooling after solvothermal reaction, analogous to R-Dy6.

properties.summary: χmT(300 K) = 67.90 cm3 K mol−1 (below 85.02 cm3 K mol−1 for six free Dy(III)), falling to 29.66 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K; M(2 K, 7 T) = 26.67 Nβ, with non-superimposable M–HT−1 plots indicating anisotropy and/or low-lying excited states. UV–vis peaks at 270 and 345 nm match the CD spectrum; S-Dy6 is the CD mirror image of R-Dy6. HRESI-MS shows stepwise Dy-ion fragmentation. Light-driven ROS/photodynamic sterilization is reported separately from cluster luminescence.
